foodConsumption.effectMerge: vanilla addEffect; preserve stronger/longer active effect behavior

beverageConsumption.effectMerge: vanilla addEffect; preserve stronger/longer active effect behavior

reverie_dreams:anti_alcohol.meaning: suppress only beverage rules marked negative while protection remains active

reverie_dreams:empty.meaning: default property factory placeholder with no gameplay behavior; not mapped to a vanilla potion

notes: All effect durations use ticks and all amplifiers are zero-based.
randomChoice is one weighted draw across the entire list, never independent per-effect chance rolls.
The negative flag is consulted only for beverage properties; food effects are unconditional once the ingredient exclusion and consumable gates pass.
Property tables preserve vanilla item membership; the items table describes only the 259 newly defined custom items.
Milk native clear_all_effects is already in foods.yml; the listener must not clear newly granted anti_alcohol after applying it.
Default property order follows source registrations; source data reload order is not guaranteed, so COOL/SPICY action ordering must be verified if a future stack combines both.
Do not write default property arrays into every item PDC: lookup defaults and honor non-empty explicit stack overrides so matching/stackability remains unchanged.
